description: This file defines the DateField class, which is used within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Fields namespace to represent a date field in document generation. It includes properties for formatting the date, serialization to DDL, cloning, and basic meta-information.

classes.name: DateField
classes.description: Represents a date field in a document, with formatting options and serialization support.

classes.name: DateField.DateFieldValues
classes.description: Holds nullable internal property values for DateField, specifically the Format property.

methods.name: DateField(DocumentObject parent)
methods.description: Constructor with parent document object, initializes BaseValues.

methods.name: Clone()
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DateField instance.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes the DateField into DDL format.

methods.name: IsNull()
methods.description: Indicates whether the DateField instance is null; always returns false.
